about: Definition of the Intel-free build variant (release/INTEL-FREE.md): an add-on and shader profile whose shipped shaders are all compiled from this project's HLSL. Every Intel-derived profile shader is left out; Intel's original pipeline then runs in its place where that is safe, and a feature that cannot run without an Intel-derived shader (generated-frame scaling, the dispatch guard with its literal-weight warps) is compiled out as a whole. Read by release/build_addon.py --variant intel-free, release/assemble.py --variant intel-free and release/check_intel_free.py.

dropped_defines.XEFG_MODEL_OWN_225792=1: Only Intel's original shaders read the 225792-byte model in this build (d95deb5ed92e496a, whose replacement is Intel-derived, and d5836bd2e22369b9, never replaced): the buffer stays the SDK's own, unexpanded. v15 (research q23) and earlier shipped without this definition.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_DOWN_FILTERS=1: Scaling only: the area filter selects area-frame-warp-*/area-flow-preprocess, Intel-derived.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_UP_FILTERS=1: Scaling only: enlargement filters run after a scaled warp, which this build does not have.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_GUARD_FULL=1: Full-resolution guard selects mfg-warp-full-literal* (Intel weights as literals) behind mfg-dispatch-guard* (Intel weight tables): Intel's original warp runs instead.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_LEAN_FULL_TRACKING=1: Root-constant tracking for the full-resolution guard only (flow_cap.h requires XEFG_MFG_GUARD_FULL).
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_GUARD_OPTI=1: Pixel-motion literal warp behind the guard.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_GUARD_FULL_NATIVE2=1: Native 2x literal warp behind the guard.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_GUARD_FULL_PIXEL2=1: Pixel-motion 2x literal warp behind the guard.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_DISPATCH_GUARD=1: The guard compares live coefficients with tables embedded in its shaders; without literal warps there is nothing to select.

drop_shaders.437542192dd795c8: Its replacement (the enlarged motion-splat tile, Intel-derived) takes half the groups per axis; Intel's original keeps its own 8x8 dispatch.

left_out_own.mfg-frame-settings.required: Marks a build with scaling controls (the installer's configure and Setup offer them when it is present).
left_out_own.mfg-upscale-filters.required: Marks a build with enlargement filters.
left_out_own.mfg-downscale-filters.required: Marks a build with the area filter.
left_out_own.mfg-dispatch-guard.required: Marks a build with the dispatch guard.
left_out_own.mfg-dispatch-guard-opti.required: Marks a build with the dispatch guard.
left_out_own.mfg-dispatch-guard-full.required: Marks a build with the dispatch guard.
left_out_own.mfg-dispatch-guard-full-native2.required: Marks a build with the dispatch guard.
left_out_own.mfg-dispatch-guard-full-pixel2.required: Marks a build with the dispatch guard.

reference: release/intel_material.json (written by release/check_intel_free.py record): hashes of the shader programs of Intel's runtime and of its warp weight tables, which the check compares against
